name: OpFin
customerProposition: Understand your money. Make better next moves.
decision: 24 September 2026: retain the OpFin monogram and Indigo, Apricot and Warm Ivory direction; establish the Progress Path, Financial Compass and Next Step as the v3 product visual language.

logo.rule: The v3 vector master is the canonical monogram source. Preserve its geometry and clear space; derive platform exports from this source.

appIcon.rule: Use the Indigo field with the approved Apricot and Warm Ivory monogram treatment. Do not add wordmark text inside the app icon.

visualLanguage.financialCompass: Separate recorded facts, estimates and unavailable information; present financial position with provenance and readable next actions.
visualLanguage.nextStep: One recommended action with a clear reason and one primary action.
